name: Frijoles Charros
summary: Pinto beans simmered with bacon, onion, and tomato into a smoky stew, served over rice.
instructions: Cook the bacon in a large pot over medium heat 6–8 minutes until browned. Leave the fat in the pot.
Add the onion and cook 5 minutes, then the garlic, cumin, chili, and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, and broth. Simmer uncovered 20 minutes, mashing a few beans to thicken it.
Cook the rice: 300 g rice with 600 mL water, simmered covered for 15 minutes, then rested 5 minutes.
Taste before adding salt. Serve the beans in bowls over the rice.

glutenFree.notes: Beans, bacon, tomatoes, and rice are naturally gluten-free. Check the bacon and broth labels.

budgetNotes: Freeze the other half of the bacon pack for next time, or for Sopa de Lentejas.
Traditionally cooked with sliced hot dogs as well as bacon. It's cowboy food. Add them if you have them.
